reason: Successor root closure for the real Product Final packaged Windows failure on PR #615 head 90015565d5c3916dfc963ac2e0eff85800ca79c8, run 32615334130, job 97135022629. Yance.exe remained alive for the full harness window but no post-install-launch.json was emitted. Fresh source audit proves electron/main.js waitForBackendReadyForActivation silently creates a default 60000 ms timer when activation deliberately supplies no timeout after #684 delegated timing authority to the backend lifecycle. The 60 s rejection aborts activation before sendActivation/writePostInstallLaunchReceipt while the process remains alive; Product Final then times out at 120 s. Close only this residual same-root authority composition defect. No timeout inflation, Product Final weakening, browser/source surrogate, workflow change, new readiness authority, or unrelated scope expansion is authorized.
